mintAuthority.summary: USDGLO is issuer-native on six EVM chains and Stellar. The six GloDollarV3 UUPS proxies consolidate MINTER_ROLE, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, PAUSER_ROLE, and UPGRADER_ROLE in one Brale-operated EOA with no on-chain cap; the Stellar issuer account independently retains revocable and clawback-enabled authorization. Brale operates the 1:1 issuance backend and publishes monthly reserve reports.

upgradeability.controlRef: Brale operator EOA (sole MINTER_ROLE + DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE + UPGRADER_ROLE holder on all 6 EVM chains)

controls.label: Brale operator EOA (sole MINTER_ROLE + DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE + UPGRADER_ROLE holder on all 6 EVM chains)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25712335, Base 49713974, Optimism 155309260, Celo 74316538, Polygon 91674848, and Arbitrum 492492610, this codeless address still holds MINTER_ROLE, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, PAUSER_ROLE, and UPGRADER_ROLE on each deterministic-address deployment. The token mint has no numeric supply ceiling, and DEFAULT_ADMIN/UPGRADER authority can change authorization or logic, so this direct minter can raise the effective economic cap without a timelock or multisig.

controls.label: Brale issuance backend
controls.evidence: Brale operates the centralized 1:1 mint/redeem backend for eligible customers against segregated cash and U.S. government-backed debt. The backend controls the uncapped EVM operator key and Stellar issuer authorization, so it can originate additional issuance rather than merely consume a fixed allowance.

controls.label: USDGLO Stellar issuer account
controls.evidence: At Horizon ledger 63861135, the USDGLO issuer has one signer of weight 1, thresholds all zero, and account flags auth_revocable=true and auth_clawback_enabled=true. Stellar credit-asset issuance has no numeric protocol cap; the issuer signer can authorize balances and claw them back directly.

review.evidence: Fresh 2026-08-08 reads confirm the same codeless Brale operator holds MINTER_ROLE, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, PAUSER_ROLE, and UPGRADER_ROLE on all six EVM deployments at Ethereum block 25712335 / Base 49713974 / Optimism 155309260 / Celo 74316538 / Polygon 91674848 / Arbitrum 492492610. ERC-1967 implementation slots remain 0xf8dbe4f52b7d4fe90cd360aa4f49b7a66783c56f (Ethereum/Polygon), 0x693b51c1ce5c6e98d71c26ed2c6b3764d8db9cf8 (Base/Optimism/Arbitrum), and 0x865dda29597ce5f9404c5a56f643492720f2433f (Celo). Horizon ledger 63861135 confirms the Stellar issuer's single signer plus revocable and clawback flags. No on-chain supply cap, timelock, or multisig bounds either issuance lane. Brale publishes monthly reserve reports, including the June 2026 report, so reconciliation is periodic; money-transmitter/MSB status is not prudential stablecoin supervision.
